messages:
Maya: Heads-up — I've ceremonially repaired the Mochi Hat after last week's confetti incident. Who wants to rock it at Friday's All-Hands? :crown: :tada:
Aj: me me me. I will sing the opening haiku.
Sana: lol no, Aj will definitely use it for excessive dance moves. nominate @Carl instead — he respects headwear.
Carl: I accept. Will practice slow, dignified nods.
Marisol: vote for Maya. She's been holding it down in kitchen patrol.
Maya: happy to loan, but propose Hat Ritual: whoever wears it must bring snacks. Mochi (the plush) enforces this.
reactions-bot: (poll created) options: Aj / Carl / Maya / Mystery Donor. current votes: Carl 1, Aj 1
Aj: fine — snacks included. I'm bringing mini churros. :churros: (yes that is a thing)
Sana: deal. also we need a ceremonial name — "Supreme Snack-Sovereign"?
Carl: I will accept title if given an official Slack emoji. @design can we get a tiny crown emoji? :crown:
Maya: agreed. closing poll at 5pm today. winner gets Mochi Hat + temporary "Snack-Sovereign" role in Slack. :sparkles:
(thumbs-up reactions all around)
